paper_statement: On NAS architecture ranking, the RLM attains average Kendall tau 0.461, outperforming Arch2Vec 0.212 and CATE 0.238, exceeding GNN 0.429, and approximately matching FLAN 0.459.

protocol.evaluation: Rank the remaining target search-space architectures; target-shot rows must be excluded.

acceptance.negative_control: Shuffled targets must not exceed the GNN average threshold of 0.429.
